description: Design requirements, not implemented/proved claims. Paths are repository-relative.

requirements.title: Immutable content and explicit digest conflicts
requirements.implementation_note: Logical payload bindings are immutable; real digest binding/collision handling remains open.

requirements.title: Distinct exact Message-ID and content/local identities
requirements.implementation_note: Exact Message-ID strings, content subjects and local numbers remain distinct. Article-field extraction validates the RFC identifier grammar, preserves exact octets and reports duplicates explicitly; native identity/signature composition remains open.

requirements.title: Preserved source variants and honest provenance
Conflicting evidence is not resolved by arrival time
requirements.implementation_note: Exchange retains competing content/provenance facts and reports conflict without arrival-time selection.

requirements.title: Atomic local memberships and non-reused article numbers
requirements.implementation_note: Logical acceptance has atomic membership and general number/binding preservation proofs.

requirements.title: Origin identity/incarnation independent of wall-clock order
Native author signatures, legacy provenance, scoped authority
Deterministic encoding and value round trips
requirements.implementation_note: Primitive/schema-0 full round trips and accepted-input canonicality certified; 38 independent cbor2 cases pass. Native schemas/signature preimages remain open.

requirements.title: Bounded parsing without Lisp evaluation
requirements.implementation_note: Wire event accounting, article syntax recognition/component bounds, UTF-8 scalar/progress bounds, wildmat parser/matcher correspondence, and CBOR/record guard verification are certified. Untrusted input still uses bounded octet marshalling. Full parser work/allocation and host graph guards remain open.

requirements.title: Versioned domain-separated hash/signature preimages
Explicit schema evolution and opaque unknown objects
Authoritative committed state and complete derived indexes
requirements.implementation_note: Immutable local transaction files are replayed by ACL2 into complete node articles, memberships, and pins. No disk indexes/checkpoints or full correspondence proof yet.

requirements.title: Atomic acceptance includes memberships and obligations
requirements.implementation_note: Actual CLI persists one complete cross-post with archive obligation, then publishes through the same ACL2 node. General physical transaction/refinement theorem remains open.

requirements.title: Success follows a matching durable commit
requirements.implementation_note: Actual file/kernel completion ordering and arbitrary finite stable-history/success-prefix proofs are certified; composed live completion calls actual node semantics before acknowledgement. Real syscall/process-death tests pass. Full adapter adoption/refinement and qualified physical persistence remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Uncertain persistence fences mutations pending recovery
requirements.implementation_note: Recovery/read/publication/completion faults fence mutations; 47 injected cases and six process-death boundaries preserve the applicable obligations. Closed/read-only owners now reject mutation and lock lifecycle regressions pass. Live wrapper adoption and physical refinement remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Recovery preserves acknowledged commits without partial transactions
requirements.implementation_note: General finite file traces retain earlier acknowledged records under named stable-storage and ghost-history premises; 211-state/9038-edge bounded exploration, fault injection and actual process reopen/lost-success retries pass. Freshness, host composition and platform qualification remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Checkpoints preserve complete future-relevant state
requirements.implementation_note: Logical checkpoint plus suffix replay equivalence is implemented; persisted checkpoint bytes, generation publication, crash selection and freshness remain open.

requirements.title: Compaction preserves protected content across crashes
Detected corruption has an explicit fault and repair path
requirements.implementation_note: Real frame checksum/truncation/schema/namespace faults refuse normal recovery. Repair workflow and old-valid-store rollback detection remain open.

requirements.title: Crash model includes torn/reordered writes and explicit barriers
requirements.implementation_note: Abstract isolated-slot model plus real adapter barriers and injected failures. No claim that the slot model is already a proved refinement of this adapter or a qualified power-loss model.

requirements.title: Known abort, uncertainty, and lost volatile state are distinct
requirements.implementation_note: Attempted-publication and completion uncertainty fence mutation; real rejected/lost completion and allocator-barrier recovery tests pass. File-kernel traces model absent/exact and old/new crash choices; general trace refinement remains open.

requirements.title: Media corruption and node loss have separately scoped claims
Delay, replay, clock error, and liveness assumptions are explicit
Persist scoped accepted obligations before receipts
requirements.implementation_note: Real local records persist the archive obligation with content; recovered article-to-pin relations checked. Forwarding receipts remain unimplemented.

requirements.title: Reserve capacity and refuse unaffordable obligations
requirements.implementation_note: Abstract reservations compose with acceptance; local adapter also refuses configured bounds and tests duplicates at capacity. Physical-space reservation accounting remains open.

requirements.title: Receipts distinguish transmission, retention, and delivery
requirements.implementation_note: A06 now places BPv7 integration, durable workflow records and application receipts on the active path; current design/exit is specs/bp-path.md. This is an assignment, not completion evidence.

requirements.title: Release requires matching committed authorized evidence
requirements.implementation_note: Exact supplied evidence gates ledger release; general release preserves valid accounting, unrelated pins, and known identities. Real authorization, committed-receipt verification, and durable node-level release remain open. A06 now places BPv7 integration, durable workflow records and application receipts on the active path; current design/exit is specs/bp-path.md. This is an assignment, not completion evidence.

requirements.title: Reclamation preserves every protected dependency closure
History pruning has explicit duplicate/resurrection semantics
Exchange portable facts rather than local database identity
requirements.implementation_note: Portable immutable fact model avoids local NNTP identity; no batch serialization yet.

requirements.title: Duplicate/reordered ingestion converges within stated scope
requirements.implementation_note: Duplicate/reordered whole-batch fact merging is tested/proved under explicit capacity/validation conditions.

requirements.title: Resumable bounded batches validate complete dependencies
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded in-memory fragment assembly has preservation/accounting/gap/work proofs. The experimental canonical BP ADU and actual durable sender/receiver journals now compose through a real two-node BPA exchange, including lost receipt and distinct-BID duplicate. Persistent fragmented progress, portable dependency closure and multi-object batches remain open.

requirements.title: Useful transfer without interactive inventory discovery
Durable scheduling with resource and fairness policy
requirements.implementation_note: BPv7 is active M3/M4 work. Durable enqueue, submission intent/outcome, explicit retry decisions, recovered receiver acceptance and returned application receipt are implemented in the bounded laboratory profile. Finite sender traces preserve state/node; scheduling fairness, non-overlapping contact plans and conditional progress remain open.

requirements.title: BP/LTP preserves fn application acceptance semantics
requirements.implementation_note: A real pinned dtn7-rs TCP-CLA loopback exchange exercised fn sender work, outage/restart, receiver acceptance, lost receipt, receiver restart, new-BID duplicate and return receipt into durable sender state. BPA observations cannot discharge application work or archive pins. Authentication, LTP, multi-relay contact plans and physical/platform qualification remain open; the evidence also retains a subsequent forwarding-deadline failure.

requirements.title: Advertised capabilities match fully audited bundles
requirements.implementation_note: Laboratory reader advertises VERSION/IMPLEMENTATION only; complete planned bundle audit pending.

requirements.title: NNTP cursor transitions and error semantics
requirements.implementation_note: Reader subset includes LISTGROUP ranges/cursors, filtered ACTIVE/NEWSGROUPS, empty results, syntax/availability errors and explicit command bounds. Logical, socket and independent-client cases pass. Full session refinement remains open.

requirements.title: Bounded framing independent of socket chunk boundaries
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded wire-state preservation, fixed-mode partition theorem, and event-yield/socket boundary tests exist.

requirements.title: Article injection and provenance follow the selected profile
requirements.implementation_note: A narrow proto-article subset checks Message-ID/Newsgroups multiplicity/grammar and absence of Injection-Info/Xref while preserving source field views. Full injection, gateway provenance, dates, native signatures and authority policy remain open.

requirements.title: POST success is durable retained acceptance with safe retries
NNTP views reflect complete committed membership
requirements.implementation_note: Actual recovered memberships feed LISTGROUP and filtered ACTIVE/NEWSGROUPS through ACL2. Independent client tests exact stored views. Complete reader/overview/profile guarantees remain open.

requirements.title: Host executes the proved core or a justified refinement
requirements.implementation_note: Simulator, socket reader, and file-store bridge invoke actual ACL2 definitions. Raw-execution guards and production host packaging remain open.

requirements.title: Identified completions, serialization, bounded effects
requirements.implementation_note: Single-owner logical transactions and bounded serial loopback bridge exercised; durable effects/production concurrency open.

requirements.title: Platform adapter meets the persistence contract
requirements.implementation_note: POSIX adapter has 47 enumerated syscall/completion fault rows, six process-death boundaries, ownership/lifecycle regressions and actual ACL2 reopen. Logical file and live completion correspondence are certified components. Hardware durability and complete host refinement remain open. The composed adapter now reports physical observations through fn-sn and consumes a one-use completion opportunity; callback uncertainty cannot reopen mutation by retrying finish. Logical mixed-trace and observed recovery gates are certified; full physical qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Certification and host trust boundaries are explicit
requirements.implementation_note: Logical certification excludes program-mode host helpers; evidence documents trusted ACL2/runtime/adapter boundaries.

requirements.title: Explicit private-profile trust and metadata boundaries
Separate ciphertext retention, archives, and secret state
Explicit private authorship and equality-leakage policy
Evaluate established group crypto against disconnection and recovery
